name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana - Crop Insurance)
action_summary: Issue localized crop loss claim and delayed sowing compensation forms

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Restructuring / Interest Subvention Scheme
action_summary: Initiate bank branch intimation for 12-month loan restructuring and interest subvention

name: PM-AASHA / e-NAM Procurement Support
action_summary: Register farmer at designated APMC MSP procurement center or facilitate WDRA warehouse pledge loan

name: State Drought Relief Package (Odisha SDRF)
action_summary: Enlist farmer for district vulnerability contingency input assistance and electricity tariff subsidy under Odisha SDRF
benefit_type: Input Subsidy and Vulnerability Safety Net

name: PM-KISAN Direct Benefit Transfer (installment check)
action_summary: Verify Aadhaar seeding and expedite direct benefit transfer release of Rs.2,000

name: KALIA (Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation) - Odisha
action_summary: Verify KALIA enrollment; facilitate Rs.10,000/season crop cultivation support for small/marginal farmers; Rs.50,000 life insurance
benefit_type: Odisha State Crop Cultivation Support and Livelihood Assistance

name: BALARAM (Zero-Interest Crop Loan - Odisha SHG Scheme)
action_summary: Link farmer to Self-Help Group (SHG) network for zero-interest crop loan up to Rs.50,000; exit informal moneylender debt cycle
benefit_type: Zero-Interest Institutional Credit / Informal Debt Exit
